headline: Agents Gain a Reliable Route to the Web
lede: Agent-Reach turns fragmented platform access into a managed capability layer for autonomous systems. Its primary-and-fallback dispatch architecture keeps agents moving across GitHub, Reddit, YouTube, and other sources while credentials remain stored locally.

headline: Caveman Cuts the Cost of Agent Conversation
lede: Caveman places a practical proxy between coding agents and their noisy inputs. It compresses logs, JSON, code, and prose locally, preserving recoverable SQLite backups while targeting a reported 65% reduction in output tokens.

headline: Superpowers Gives Coding Agents a Work Plan
lede: Superpowers replaces improvisation with a staged engineering process: clarify requirements, validate a design, plan the work, then implement it in tested increments. Worktrees, TDD, and review checkpoints turn agentic development into a sequence that can be inspected and repeated.

headline: Ponytail Teaches Agents to Write Less
lede: Ponytail gives coding agents a stubbornly simple decision ladder: use the platform, standard library, or existing code before adding anything new. Its minimalist rules aim to cut dependencies and latency without trading away security, accessibility, or error handling.

headline: Impeccable Gives AI Design Taste
lede: Impeccable brings critique, accessibility, responsive behavior, typography, and polish into the coding agent’s daily toolkit. Its deterministic detectors and documented product context push generated interfaces beyond generic cards, gradients, and indistinct SaaS layouts.

headline: A Working Library for Disciplined Agents
lede: Matt Pocock’s skills repository collects reusable practices for agents that need to reason like professional engineers. TDD, domain modeling, documentation checks, and requirement alignment arrive as composable commands rather than a sealed orchestration system.

headline: OpenShell Puts Agents Behind Policy Walls
lede: NVIDIA OpenShell gives autonomous agents a controlled operating boundary instead of unrestricted access to a host. Sandboxes, kernel-level enforcement, credential handling, and human-reviewed policy changes make least privilege an operational feature rather than a promise.

headline: Marketing Skills Turn Agents into Operators
lede: Marketingskills packages SEO, conversion optimization, copywriting, and growth workflows as interoperable markdown skills. A shared product-marketing foundation keeps specialized tasks aligned with the product, audience, and brand as agents move from analysis to execution.

headline: HyperFrames Renders the Web as Video
lede: HyperFrames treats HTML, CSS, and media assets as the source material for deterministic MP4 production. Browser-previewable compositions, animation skills, audio workflows, and a CLI router give creative teams a programmable path from interface to finished motion.

headline: Context Mode Keeps Agents on the Signal
lede: Context Mode moves heavy analysis out of the conversation and into sandboxed execution, returning only the results an agent needs. SQLite persistence, FTS5 indexing, and BM25 retrieval preserve decisions and progress across long-running work without replaying entire sessions.
